# v1.12.0 — FCM push notifications and mobile photo uploads

## Real device push notifications

- Added the FCM delivery pipeline so tagged users can receive Google push notifications while the app is closed. The backend stores per-device tokens, sends authenticated Firebase HTTP v1 messages, caches and refreshes service-account credentials, prunes stale tokens, and treats delivery failures as best-effort so a push failure cannot break the triggering API call.
- Added mobile Firebase Messaging integration: register tokens at login and on resume, handle token rotation, process notification taps into board deep links, and remove tokens on logout/server change.
- Made the Android Google Services Gradle plugin conditional on `google-services.json`, allowing builds without Firebase configuration to continue working. CI can add the Android Firebase config when the repository secret is present.
- Kept ntfy/in-app notification behavior as the fallback and documented Firebase setup.

## Camera uploads and thumbnail fixes included since the previous published release

- Added a mobile **Slikaj** camera flow with a date-prefilled editable filename, JPEG upload, best-effort downscaling, and clean cancellation.
- Fixed thumbnail generation for uploads whose client-supplied MIME type is generic by detecting image formats from their bytes; camera JPEGs are stored with the correct image MIME type.
- Changed mobile file rows to load the server’s small authenticated thumbnails instead of downloading full-size originals; added a loading placeholder for the grid.

## Verification

- Backend Python compilation and Flutter 3.24.3 analysis passed; all 17 Flutter tests passed. The photo flow and thumbnail endpoint are covered by widget tests.
- Mobile package version: **1.12.0+14**. Camera/photo work from v1.11.0 is included in this release range; there is no separate published v1.11.0 GitHub release.
